review_candidates.title: Sharepoint Developer
review_candidates.description: Shift: EMEA (03:00 PM IST to 12:00 AM IST) Experience: 3-5 years of overall experience (1-3 years of relevant experience) Primary Skills - SharePoint Online, PNP Powershell, SharePoint Framework (SPFx), JavaScript/TypeScript Secondary Skills - Microsoft Graph, Power Automate, Microsoft 365 Integration We are seeking a motivated SharePoint Developer to join our Collaboration Experience team. In this role, you will design, build, and support SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 solutions that improve employee and customer experiences. This role is ideal for a developing professional who has a solid technical foundation, is growing their expertise, and consistently applies standards and best practices to solve problems of moderate scope. As SharePoint Developer, you will work closely with peers, team members, and internal customers, receiving general guidance while exercising increasing independence in execution, problemsolving, and prioritization. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain SharePoint Online solutions including sites, lists, libraries, and User-side customizations. Build and support SPFx web parts and extensions in accordance with team coding standards. Integrate Microsoft 365 services (Teams, Power Platform, Microsoft Graph) as needed. Troubleshoot and resolve issues of moderate complexity while following company policies and technical guidelines. Deliver high-quality, maintainable solutions focused on usability, performance, and scalability. Collaborate effectively with team members, management, and internal stakeholders to accomplish shared goals. Communicate clearly, professionally, and incorporate customer feedback to refine solutions. Proactively identify & address technical challenges, risks, and recommend solutions. Pursue continuous learning and improvement in SharePoint and Microsoft 365 technologies. Take ownership of work, balancing speed, quality, and feature development to meet project commitments. Demonstrate company culture values through respectful, inclusive, and collaboration. Required Skills & Qualifications Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to adhere to development processes, standards, and best practices. Practical experience with SharePoint Online (sites, lists, libraries, permissions, SharePoint Admin portal) and automation tools such as Power Automate and Azure Runbooks. Proficiency in PowerShell scripting, including PNP PowerShell and SharePoint Online Management Shell. Experience with web development technologies such as JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS, and foundational knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx). Familiarity with Microsoft 365 services, integration techniques, REST APIs, and Microsoft Graph. Experience with AirTable is an advantage. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 1–3 years of relevant experience in SharePoint Online Microsoft solutions.

review_candidates.title: System Test Engineer (Hardware & Software / FAA)
review_candidates.description: Want to learn more about this role and Jobot? Click our Jobot logo and follow our LinkedIn page! Job details: Engineers who have experience with telecommunications, networking, VoIP, Air Traffic Management, or other mission-critical communication systems & local to the DMV NEED TO APPLY asap! This Jobot Job is hosted by: Craig Rosecrans Are you a fit? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button and sending us your resume. Salary: $120,000 - $170,000 per year A bit about us: An established engineering organization supporting mission-critical communications systems is seeking a System Test Engineer to join its Test & Integration team. This position focuses on system-level testing of complex hardware and software solutions supporting highly available communications environments. The engineer will participate in informal testing, customer acceptance testing, and integration activities while working closely with engineering teams and end users. The role is hybrid but requires candidates to spend significant time onsite during Formal Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities with customers. Why join us? Our client offers highly competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative, people-first culture that promotes innovation, professional growth, and long-term career development. We are committed to creating an environment where employees are empowered to make an impact, work alongside highly talented teams, and contribute to meaningful, mission-critical initiatives in a supportive and forward-thinking workplace. Job Details Position Summary We are seeking a highly technical System Test Engineer to support the integration, testing, troubleshooting, and customer acceptance of proprietary safety-critical voice communication systems. This individual will work across software, networking, and hardware environments to identify and resolve technical issues, support last-mile system integration, and ensure solutions are ready for formal customer acceptance testing. The ideal candidate combines strong hands-on troubleshooting skills with the communication ability and technical credibility to work directly with knowledgeable FAA and contractor engineering teams. Key Responsibilities * Develop and execute formal system-level test procedures and verification activities. * Create comprehensive test plans, verification procedures, test documentation, and requirements traceability. * Troubleshoot and debug proprietary safety-critical voice communication systems across software, networking, and hardware environments. * Support last-mile integration of voice communication products within customer environments. * Perform functional, integration, performance, security, and system-level testing. * Support and participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and formal customer acceptance testing. * Interface directly with FAA and contractor engineers during testing, system demonstrations, troubleshooting, and acceptance activities. * Investigate, reproduce, document, and communicate software, network, and hardware defects to engineering teams. * Review system requirements and ensure appropriate test coverage. * Manage laboratory test environments, equipment, configurations, and test scripts. * Collaborate with software, systems, network, and hardware engineering teams to troubleshoot complex system issues. * Maintain detailed test records and clearly communicate test results, technical issues, and resolutions to engineering leadership and customers. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree, at minimum, in Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or a related technical discipline. * 5+ years of system-level hardware/software testing, systems integration, or closely related engineering experience. * Strong ability to troubleshoot and debug complex software and networking issues, with additional exposure to hardware troubleshooting. * Experience working with mission-critical communications, voice systems, networking, telecommunications, or similar complex technology environments. * Strong experience developing and executing formal system test procedures and documentation. * Experience supporting Factory Acceptance Testing, customer acceptance testing, or other formal customer-facing technical evaluations. * Strong networking and systems troubleshooting skills. * Ability to communicate confidently and technically with experienced customer engineers. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Experience * Experience comprehensively testing the security and performance of proprietary, hardened voice communication systems. * Air Traffic Management or FAA program experience. * Safety-critical or mission-critical voice communication systems. * VoIP and telecommunications technologies. * Wireshark. * Linux. * JIRA and JAMA. * ED-137. * FAA NextGen. * DO-278A. * MIL-STD-461. * TDM, ISDN, POTS, and T1 technologies. * Oscilloscopes, Viavi T-BERD, TIMS, or similar test equipment. Interested in hearing more? Easy Apply now by clicking the "Easy Apply" button. Jobot is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide an inclusive work environment that celebrates diversity and all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. review_candidates.title: Ingénieur Administrateur Systèmes et Réseaux (H/F)
review_candidates.description: Avec plus de 30 ans d’histoire, ALTEN accompagne en France et dans le monde entier la stratégie de développement de ses clients dans les domaines de l’innovation, de la R&D et des systèmes d’information. "Être la maison des ingénieurs, telle est l'ambition d'ALTEN. » Groupe international et leader de son marché, ALTEN intervient sur tous les grands projets porteurs d'enjeux technologiques, en s'intégrant à la stratégie industrielle de ses clients (36 100 collaborateurs, dont 88% d'ingénieurs - CA annuel > 2,3 Milliards - implantation dans 28 pays). Description du poste Vos missions : En tant qu'Administrateur Systèmes et Réseaux, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le bon fonctionnement des infrastructures IT et la gestion de projets critiques sur les segments sols dans le domaine spatial (ensemble des infrastructures, systèmes et logiciels situés au sol qui permettent de gérer, contrôler et exploiter un satellite ou une mission spatiale). Vos principales responsabilités incluront : Administration des systèmes et réseaux : Gestion, optimisation et maintenance des infrastructures Linux et réseaux. Mise en œuvre et gestion des outils d’automatisation tels qu’Ansible. Orchestration et déploiement d’applications dans des environnements Kubernetes. Sécurité et résilience : Mise en place des politiques de sauvegarde et des stratégies de sécurité des données. Surveillance proactive des systèmes pour garantir leur disponibilité et leur performance. Participation aux projets d’évolution : Conception et implémentation de nouvelles architectures. Collaboration avec les équipes projet pour intégrer des solutions innovantes adaptées au secteur spatial. Qualifications Votre profil Formation : Ecole d'ingénieur ou école informatique - Bac+5. Expérience : Minimum 2 ans d'expérience en administration systèmes et réseaux, avec une spécialisation sur Linux. Compétences techniques : Expertise en Linux, Kubernetes et Ansible (prérequis). Connaissances sur les bases de données Expérience avec des solutions matérielles comme Nutanix et TCD. Compréhension des environnements de virtualisation et des technologies réseau avancées. Qualités personnelles : Capacité à gérer des projets techniques complexes. Rigueur, autonomie et esprit d’équipe. Passion pour les nouvelles technologies et le secteur spatial. Informations supplémentaires Pourquoi rejoindre ALTEN Toulouse ? En intégrant ALTEN, vous évoluerez dans un environnement stimulant qui valorise votre expertise métier, tout en vous offrant des opportunités d’évolution et de formation continue. Vous serez entouré(e) d'une équipe de passionnés, avec un fort esprit d’innovation, qui contribue activement aux projets stratégiques de nos clients du secteur aéronautique et spatial. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) en électronique pour intervenir sur des projets innovants dans le secteur de l'aéronautique et du spatial.

review_candidates.description: WHO ARE WE? California Burrito is a fast-growing QSR chain with 2500+ employees across 140+ locations across Bengaluru, NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai, Mumbai and Pune. We started in 2012 with a simple belief: no compromise, just real ingredients. Since then, we’ve been serving honestly good Mexican food while building a more wholesome, sustainable way to do fast food, including growing our own fresh ingredients. Our mission is to become India’s most recognised name in Mexican cuisine while setting the standard for quality, speed and friendly hospitality. And how we get there matters just as much. We stay Open & Honest, Strive for Excellence, believe in Freedom with Ownership, and focus on Growing Every Day. THE OPPORTUNITY / ABOUT THE ROLE (Current Openings at - Chennai+Hyderabad+Pune locations) •Self-starter, ready to take on new challenges •Understanding of IT systems •High ownership levels •People management skills •Good communication skills to coordinate with internal teams and vendors WHAT WILL YOU OWN? 1. Store IT Support: • Install, configure, and maintain POS systems, billing software, and peripherals. • Handle installation, setup, and troubleshooting of printers. • Support SIM-based landline phones and manage recharges, activations, and issues. • Troubleshoot internet connectivity, Wi-Fi routers and network-related problems at stores. • Ensure smooth functioning of all IT hardware during store operating hours. 2. Maintenance & Troubleshooting: • Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues reported by store teams. • Coordinate with vendors, ISPs, POS providers, and telecom partners for issue resolution. • Perform preventive maintenance to minimize downtime. • Maintain backup devices and ensure quick replacements when required. 3. Support & Coordination: • Provide on-call/anydesk support during weekends and peak hours if required. • Train store employees on basic troubleshooting and correct usage of IT Equipments. • Maintain issue logs through Terotam and share regular status updates. • Assist during new store launches with IT setup and readiness. WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED? You’re self-driven and naturally take initiative. You’re comfortable figuring things out, taking challenges head-on and owning what happens next. You think entrepreneurially, move with intent and don’t need to be told every next step. You can bring people along, step up when something needs leadership and stay open to being challenged yourself. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Diploma/B.Tech in IT, Computer Science Engineering or Electronics Engineering. Required skills: • POS systems • Printers (thermal / billing) • Networking basics (routers, LAN, Wi-Fi) • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. • Willingness to travel to store locations if required. GET TO KNOW US BETTER Website: https://www.californiaburrito.in/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/californiaburrito_in Corporate Office: California Burrito Corporate Office, Sapota Park 1st Main Rd, 1st Cross Rd, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038

review_candidates.title: Forward Deployed Engineer — Data Engineering & GenAI
review_candidates.description: About the Role Location: Washington, DC Metro Area (Work Model: Hybrid — expected in the office/customer sites 2–3 days per week) Employment Type: Full Time Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who combines strong software and data engineering fundamentals with hands-on Generative AI expertise and exceptional customer-facing skills. This is not a traditional implementation, solutions consulting, or data engineering role. The FDE will work directly with customers to understand complex and often ambiguous operational problems, translate them into technical solutions, and then build and deploy those solutions hands-on. You will operate at the intersection of customers, data, software engineering, and Generative AI. One engagement might require building an API integration and ETL pipeline; another might involve creating an AI agent that automates an operational workflow; another could require rapidly prototyping a customer-specific application using LLMs and enterprise data. We are looking for someone who is comfortable moving between a customer conversation, architecture whiteboard, IDE, data pipeline, and production deployment. Required Qualifications Strong hands-on software engineering experience. Strong data engineering fundamentals, including ETL/ELT, data modeling, schema mapping, and data pipelines. Experience designing and integrating REST APIs and backend services. Strong Python development skills. Hands-on experience building applications using LLMs / Generative AI. Experience building at least some of: AI agents, RAG systems, tool-calling workflows, LLM-powered applications, or AI workflow automation. Ability to take an ambiguous customer requirement and independently turn it into a working technical solution. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills across applications, APIs, infrastructure, and data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Demonstrated ability to work directly with customers and senior stakeholders. Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving environments with incomplete requirements. U.S. Citizenship. Based in or willing to work from the Washington, DC metro area. Ability to work in a hybrid environment with office/customer-site presence at least 2–3 days per week. Nice to Have Experience working as a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Technical Consultant, or customer-facing Software/Data Engineer. Experience supporting the federal government, defense, intelligence, national security, or other mission-critical environments. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. Experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, dbt, or equivalent technologies. Experience with vector databases, embeddings, retrieval systems, and modern LLM application frameworks. Experience deploying AI applications into production environments. Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows and AI evaluation systems. Familiarity with enterprise security, authentication, authorization, and data-governance requirements. Demonstrated ability to develop reusable technical approaches and influence engineering or product strategy. Key Responsibilities Work directly with customers to understand business objectives, operational workflows, technical environments, and pain points. Translate ambiguous customer requirements into concrete technical architectures and working solutions. Rapidly prototype, build, test, deploy, and iterate on customer-facing solutions. Own technical delivery from initial discovery through implementation and production adoption. Make pragmatic engineering decisions balancing speed, scalability, security, maintainability, and customer impact. Identify technical risks, data-quality issues, integration constraints, and implementation trade-offs early. Write production-quality code, primarily using languages such as Python and/or TypeScript. Design and develop APIs and backend services. Integrate applications with databases, APIs, cloud services, AI models, and customer systems. Build lightweight applications and interfaces where needed to deliver an end-to-end customer solution. Apply sound software engineering practices around testing, version control, CI/CD, monitoring, security, and documentation. Design and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for ingestion, extraction, transformation, and delivery workflows. Execute bulk data processing and deliver data products in formats including Parquet, CSV, JSON, and related formats. Build, configure, test, and maintain REST/API integrations for customer and internal use cases. Design and build GenAI-powered applications that automate complex customer workflows. Build LLM-based agents and agentic workflows capable of reasoning across enterprise data, APIs, and tools. Develop RAG pipelines connecting LLMs with structured and unstructured enterprise data. Implement tool/function calling, structured outputs, workflow orchestration, and multi-step AI systems. Build evaluation frameworks and feedback loops to measure and improve AI application quality.

review_candidates.description: Department: Service - Field Service Location: UK/Field based Description An excellent entry point into engineering If you’re early in your engineering career and motivated by problem-solving, technology, practical work, good attention to detail, and understanding the importance of job-related admin, this role offers a strong foundation and clear development opportunities. Field service experience isn’t essential — however, we’re looking for some work experience in a customer-facing environment that can demonstrate reliability, punctuality, and adherence to scheduled working hours — we’re hiring for potential. Not a 100% match? Apply anyway. If you’ve got the right attitude, we can help you build the rest. Field-based (home-start) | Company Vehicle | Full Training Provided | Driving Licence Required. Working pattern This is a field role, so start/finish times vary with customer needs and travel. Core hours apply; however, because of the nature of the job, flexibility is required. Weekend rota & earning opportunity This role includes participation in a weekend/bank holiday support rota with additional pay. Potential of additional earnings through Weekend and Bank Holiday Rota participation. Opportunities to earn more by taking on additional weekend cover when available. Plus potential bonus and salary progression, subject to performance and business results. Long-term career progression Progression Opportunities Exist For The Right Person, Including Technical progression (advanced diagnostics, product expertise, specialist support). Leadership/management progression (coaching, planning, field leadership). Key Responsibilities What you’ll do Start your day from home, head to customer sites, and manage jobs through our field service system. Meet the customer, understand the issue, and keep them updated as you resolve the problem. Use a Windows laptop to review system logs, run checks, and record your work. Carry out basic connectivity and setup tasks (LAN connections, IP settings, accessing device interfaces). We teach this step-by-step. Complete preventative maintenance (cleaning, checks, basic adjustments) and replace modules/parts when needed. Test the equipment and clearly document what you’ve done before leaving. Use quieter time for structured learning and training modules. Service levels & priority work You’ll work to agreed service levels (SLAs) that help keep customer sites running. Most work is planned maintenance and scheduled visits. When a site has a time-critical issue, you’ll prioritise it with support from scheduling and technical teams. Our aim is always a first-time fix and minimal disruption for the customer. Training & support Structured onboarding and shadowing. Product training and access to learning modules/Academy development. Ongoing support from schedulers, technical support, and field leadership. Essential What we’re looking for Full UK driving licence. Interest and understanding of engineering/technology (college course, projects, hobbies or practical experience). Comfortable using a Windows laptop and learning new software. Some experience of a workplace environment (e.g., part-time job, placement, internship, volunteering or similar) that shows you can be reliable, punctual and customer focused. A professional, customer-friendly approach — you represent GLORY on site. Preferred: Some basic networking knowledge (e.g., using Ethernet/LAN, understanding IP addresses, simple connectivity checks). Networking self-check (preferred): If you’ve ever set a static IP, logged into a router, or fixed a “no internet” problem at home, not just followed the steps but understand the logic behind them — you’ll fit right in. Great fit backgrounds, (examples): college leavers from engineering/IT/technical courses; PC builders; retail/hospitality/customer service roles; practical hobbyists (vehicles/bikes, electronics, DIY repairs, Arduino/Raspberry Pi). Job Benefits With Glory, you will be working for an Investors in People Gold accredited company. 25 days' holiday a year plus bank holidays with the opportunity to buy up to five additional days Company vehicle that is available for private use Tools and parts support Competitive company pension scheme Ongoing training and development Private medical insurance for all employees (enhanced membership can be purchased for other family members) Dental insurance for all employees Life assurance Income protection scheme Employee assistance programme Employee Wellbeing events and Mental Health First Aiders Employee My Benefits portal offering extensive retail discount

review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: Do you thrive at the intersection of development and infrastructure? Foundation FSSC is seeking a DevOps Engineer who can build Azure solutions that power global food safety certification for 40,000+ organizations worldwide. If you're a developer who loves automating infrastructure, designing scalable cloud solutions, and making a real-world impact through technology, this role offers the perfect blend of coding, DevOps, and meaningful work. Please note: Foundation FSSC can only consider applications from candidates living and working in the Netherlands, who can attend the 's-Hertogenbosch office regularly. About the job (32-40 hours) As DevOps Engineer at Foundation FSSC, you'll be responsible for building and managing the Azure Assurance Platform infrastructure that supports their global certification schemes. Working hybrid and from ’s-Hertogenbosch , you'll combine development skills with infrastructure expertise designing .NET solutions while setting up and managing the Azure environment that enables development teams to build solutions for thousands of certified organizations worldwide. You'll collaborate with a dynamic IT team of approximately 22 professionals and report to the Manager Software Engineering & Architecture. Your role focus In this role, you balance platform reliability with engineering enablement. Your focus is roughly divided as follows: DevOps excellence (70%) You ensure a secure, scalable, and well-monitored Azure environment. By applying Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform and Bicep) and CI/CD practices (Azure DevOps), you create a reliable platform that development teams can build on with confidence. Solution design & engineering enablement (25%) FSSC has some services and utilities, built in .Net, which support the platform. The .Net knowledge is needed to enable project teams to work faster and more consistently, applying standard frameworks and sound design principles. Technical support & expertise (5%) You support project teams and second-line support with technical questions and incident resolution, acting as a trusted technical sparring partner. Your key responsibilities In your day-to-day work, this translates into the following responsibilities: Set up, manage, and expand Azure infrastructure for software development teams, including services such as Azure API Management, Azure Monitor, Entra ID, and Event Grid Develop and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and CI/CD pipelines using Terraform and Azure DevOps Design and develop cross-cutting .NET solutions together with the WEM Solution Designer, Front-end Technical Lead, and Architect Implement and manage authentication and authorization solutions using Entra ID and Entra External ID Ensure security best practices are applied, including OAuth2, OIDC, and OWASP guidelines Work closely with architects, development team members, and product owners to implement and deliver infrastructural changes Ensure proper documentation of infrastructure components being built or modified Monitor and optimize Azure capacity to ensure scalable, high-performing, and cost-efficient environments Provide technical guidance to project teams and second-line support on infrastructure-related topics This is where you will work Since 2009, Foundation FSSC has been the independent provider of Certification Schemes for ISO-aligned Management Systems. Almost 40,000 organizations worldwide, including premium A-brands, are certified to the FSSC 22000 Scheme for Food Safety. FSSC 24000 for Social Sustainability was published in 2022. Both Certification Programs contribute to FSSC's vision to create a better world by helping organizations achieve impact through the UN Sustainable Development Goals. This is what is required This vacancy is slightly different from the one FSSC recruited for in January 2026. We're looking for someone who combines technical depth with strong collaboration skills. You're analytical, proactive in raising concerns, and have a strong sense of ownership. You have proven experience coordinating DevOps activities, including task planning and operational updates, and thrive in a team-oriented, international environment. Fluent English communication is essential. Your essential technical qualifications and experience: 5+ years development experience (.Net/ C# strongly preferred) Microsoft Azure expertise including Integration solutions (API Management, EventGrid), Observability (Azure Monitor), and PaaS solutions (Container Apps, Function Apps, Azure Storage) Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform and hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps Azure CLI proficiency for automation and scripting Identity and Access Management experience with Entra ID and Entra External ID Azure recourse management with Bicep Security knowledge of OAuth2, OIDC, and OWASP best practices Familiarity with no-code/low-code platforms such as WEM (nice to have) The offer If a healthy work-life balance and agile working within an international environment is top of your wish list, then as a DevOps Engineer at FSSC, you've come to the right place. In addition, you can also count on: A competitive salary Ample opportunities for personal development An open culture within a flexible organisation Colleagues who enjoy their work and are passionate about their company Want to respond? Ready to combine your development skills with Azure infrastructure expertise for global food safety? If you believe you're the DevOps Engineer for Foundation FSSC, apply now. Questions about this DevOps Engineer role at Foundation FSSC in 's-Hertogenbosch? Contact recruiter Karst Dollekamp: Call or WhatsApp: +31 6 43 01 18 71 Email: karstdollekamp@epeople.nl Watch this video for a quick impression of the role: https://www.linkedin.com/smart-links/AQGlDVInstsWXw Or visit the e-people website, where you’ll find many more videos related to this vacancy, including an interview with a direct colleague and a great video explaining what FSSC does and the impact of its work.

review_candidates.description: Product Support Engineer (Junior to Mid-Level)   Company:  99 Games Hub Ltd Location:  Bristol / Hybrid with on-site work required Type:  Full-time Level:  Junior to Mid-Level Salary:  £26,000–£28,000 depending on experience   About 99 Games Hub Ltd 99 Games Hub Ltd is a UK-based technology company developing  99Shuffle , an innovative interactive shuffleboard gaming system for the leisure, hospitality and entertainment sectors. Our product combines physical gameplay, digital scoring, tablets, PCs, cameras, software, and interactive venue experiences to help customers create a more engaging and modern entertainment offering. We are an early-stage company preparing to bring 99Shuffle to market. This means the role is hands-on, practical and varied. You will be involved in support, setup, testing, customer assistance, product preparation and helping us improve the system as we grow.   About the role   We are looking for a motivated and hands-on  Product Support & Setup Engineer  to join our team and support the launch and operation of 99Shuffle. This role is ideal for someone who is technically minded, practical, reliable and keen to learn. You do  not  need to be highly experienced, as training will be provided. What matters most is that you are passionate about technology, willing to learn, able to work hard, and committed to helping us deliver a great product and customer experience. You will support customers and venue partners, help prepare and configure equipment, test new features, investigate issues, document problems clearly, and assist with product setup before and after launch. This is a broad role where you will gain experience across technical support, product testing, customer operations, installation preparation, hardware/software setup, and basic troubleshooting.     Key responsibilities   • Support system setup, installation and testing at customer sites where required.  • Provide first-line and second-line technical support to customers and venue partners using 99Shuffle over the email and phone. • Prepare and pre-stage PCs using tools such as Clonezilla, tablets and related equipment before deployment.  • Help configure tablets, PCs, network settings, software builds and venue-ready systems.  • Reproduce, investigate and document bugs or customer-reported issues.  • Assist with software updates, deployment preparation and launch readiness.  • Support system calibration, camera checks, gameplay testing and operational validation.  • Help create simple support guides, setup notes and troubleshooting documentation.  • Work closely with the product and development team to prioritise issues affecting customers.  • Share recurring customer issues and product feedback to help improve 99Shuffle over time.  • Support general operational tasks needed in an early-stage product business.     What we’re looking for   • Ability to communicate clearly with customers and explain technical issues in simple language.  • A proactive attitude and willingness to take ownership of tasks. • Confidence working with PCs, tablets, software applications and basic hardware setup. • Ability to work in a startup environment where priorities can change quickly. • A practical, hands-on mindset and a strong work ethic.     Technical skills we’d like to see   • Linux PC setup, configuration and troubleshooting. • Using efficiently the AI for help to find quicker the solution and provide better support. • Tablet setup Android and basic mobile device support.  • Imaging or cloning tools such as Clonezilla.  • Basic networking knowledge, such as IP addresses, Wi-Fi, routers, local networks and connectivity testing.  • Experience testing software or hardware-enabled systems.  • Ability to document issues clearly with screenshots, steps to reproduce and expected behaviour.    Why join us   • Full training will be provided for the right person.  • You will work directly with experienced software engineers and product leaders.  • You will gain hands-on experience across support, setup, testing, product operations and customer delivery.  • You will be involved in launching an innovative interactive gaming product.  • You will have the opportunity to grow with the business as 99Shuffle scales.  • You will play an important role in shaping how we support customers and improve the product.   Additional information   Most of the work is on-site in Bristol and occasional travel may be required for testing, setup or customer support.     How to apply   Please send your CV along with a short note explaining: • why this role interests you • any relevant experience in technical support, testing or software development • an example of a technical problem you investigated and solved

Take ownership of issues through to resolution, escalating more complex problems to appropriate local or central technology teams. Provide advice and assistance to attorneys and senior stakeholders regarding technology equipment and purchases. Deliver basic technology induction and user training. Support technology-related security systems and promote appropriate security best practices. Assist with maintaining and improving IT policies, procedures and documentation. Opportunity to join a prestigious international professional services environment. Work alongside experienced technology professionals across an international organisation. Exposure to a sophisticated legal technology and workplace technology environment. Regular interaction with senior stakeholders and business users. Broad responsibility across applications, infrastructure, hardware and end-user technology. Strong opportunity for professional development and career progression. The Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate will be a hands-on IT support professional who combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with exceptional customer service . You will enjoy being close to the business, solving problems quickly and building trusted relationships with users. Experience within a law firm or another high-performance professional services environment would be particularly valuable. If you're an experienced IT support professional looking for a Brussels-based opportunity within a highly regarded international organisation, we'd be keen to hear from you.
